title: CheckResult
description: Result of goose check without running the program. Returned by the runner's POST /check, the MCP check tool, and sent to the browser in checkFinished.

outcome.description: ok: the check passed (warnings may remain). compile_error: the check found errors. timeout: stopped at the time limit. killed: stopped by the memory or process limit.

diagnostics.description: Errors and warnings from goose check --diagnostics json. Empty when there are none.
